lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 요즘 모임에 통 안 나오네요.
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, you've hardly come to our meetings lately.
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, yojeum moime tong an naoneyo.
lines.learner: 죄송해요. 일이 바쁜 탓에 못 갔어요.
lines.en: I'm sorry. I couldn't go because work was busy.
lines.roman: Joesonghaeyo. Iri bappeun tase mot gasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Is it maybe because you felt awkward?
lines.en: Yes, honestly it still feels a bit awkward.

lines.beaver: 왜 그렇게 느꼈어요? 편하게 말해 봐요.
lines.beaver_en: Why did you feel that way? Tell me freely.
lines.beaver_roman: Wae geureoke neukkyeosseoyo? Pyeonhage malhae bwayo.
lines.learner: 선후배 사이에 공감대가 없는 탓인 것 같아요.
lines.en: I think it's because seniors and juniors lack common ground.
lines.roman: Seonhubae saie gonggamdaega eomneun tasin geot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: In what way did you feel that?
lines.en: Everyone was already close, so it was hard to fit in.

lines.beaver_en: Ah, I see. How was the savings club?
lines.learner: 계에서는 제가 신임을 못 얻은 것 같아요.
lines.en: I don't think I earned their trust in the club.
lines.roman: Gyeeseoneun jega sinimeul mot eodeun geot gatayo.

lines.beaver: 그건 오해예요. 다들 민수 씨를 믿어요.
lines.beaver_en: That's a misunderstanding. Everyone trusts you.
lines.beaver_roman: Geugeon ohaeyeyo. Dadeul minsu ssireul mideoyo.
lines.learner: 제가 말이 없는 탓에 그렇게 느꼈나 봐요.
lines.en: Maybe I felt that way because I'm so quiet.
lines.roman: Jega mari eomneun tase geureoke neukkyeonna bwayo.

lines.beaver: 우리는 다 한 식구예요. 편하게 와요.
lines.beaver_en: We're all one family. Come feeling at ease.
lines.beaver_roman: Urineun da han sikguyeyo. Pyeonhage wayo.
lines.en: Hearing that makes me feel more at ease.

lines.beaver_en: What do you think it takes to get close to people?
lines.en: I think it takes time to become close.

lines.beaver: 그럼 이번 주 모임에 나올 수 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Then can you come to this week's meeting?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom ibeon ju moime naol su isseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 이번 주부터 슬슬 다시 나갈게요.
lines.en: Yes, I'll slowly start coming again this week.
lines.roman: Ne, ibeon jubuteo seulseul dasi nagalgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Great. Everyone will be waiting for you.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll see you on Saturday.
